<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="20" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>
  <line x1="326" y1="15" x2="331" y2="15" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="334" y1="13" x2="339" y2="13" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="342" y1="11" x2="347" y2="11" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="356" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="359" y1="17" x2="362" y2="20" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="370" y="9" width="16" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="372" y="11" width="11" height="7" rx="1" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <rect x="386" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="31,61 23,68 31,75" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="68" x2="40" y2="68" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="55" y="73" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Equipaje</text>
  <circle cx="354" cy="61" r="15" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <circle cx="354" cy="57" r="3.3" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <ellipse cx="354" cy="65" rx="7" ry="4.5" fill="#1B0188"/>

  <!-- Itinerary card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="14" y="108" width="362" height="111" rx="14" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
  <rect x="14" y="106" width="362" height="111" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="31" y="129" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">TU VIAJE</text>
  <text x="31" y="157" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Cali</text>
  <text x="31" y="178" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">CLO</text>
  <line x1="89" y1="165" x2="290" y2="165" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="293,165 283,160 283,170" fill="#EA104C"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="165" r="4" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <text x="307" y="157" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Bogotá</text>
  <text x="307" y="178" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">BOG</text>
  <text x="31" y="202" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">12 jun 2024 · Vuelo de ida</text>
  <rect x="298" y="187" width="58" height="22" rx="11" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <text x="327" y="202" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">COMPLETADO</text>

  <!-- Tabs -->
  <rect x="14" y="237" width="362" height="50" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="15" y="238" width="180" height="48" rx="7" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <text x="105" y="268" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">IDA</text>
  <text x="285" y="268" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#5C5C5C">REGRESO</text>

  <!-- Informative banner -->
  <rect x="14" y="305" width="362" height="116" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="333" r="11" fill="#4658E0"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="330" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="39" y1="334" x2="39" y2="340" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="60" y="334" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">No puedes agregar equipaje</text>
  <text x="31" y="363" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#110053">Este vuelo ya fue completado, por lo que</text>
  <text x="31" y="384" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#110053">no es posible añadir equipaje a la reserva.</text>
  <text x="31" y="405" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Consulta los detalles de tu vuelo</text>
  <polyline points="334,401 339,406 344,401" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.7"/>

  <!-- Baggage section -->
  <text x="16" y="458" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Equipaje de ida</text>
  <text x="16" y="480" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cali a Bogotá · Pasajero 1</text>

  <rect x="14" y="496" width="362" height="125" rx="14" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
  <rect x="14" y="494" width="362" height="125" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- suitcase icon -->
  <rect x="34" y="530" width="35" height="42" rx="5" fill="#EFEDFA" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="44" y="522" width="15" height="10" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="43" y1="540" x2="43" y2="565" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="540" x2="60" y2="565" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="576" r="3" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="576" r="3" fill="#1B0188"/>
  <text x="88" y="529" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Equipaje de bodega</text>
  <text x="88" y="552" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Incluido en tu tarifa</text>
  <text x="88" y="579" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">1 pieza · hasta 23 kg</text>
  <circle cx="344" cy="546" r="10" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
  <polyline points="339,546 343,550 350,542" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Disabled add baggage button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="643" width="362" height="51" rx="7" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="674" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="700" fill="#858585">Añadir equipaje</text>
  </g>
  <text x="195" y="718" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">El equipaje solo puede agregarse antes del vuelo.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="756" width="390" height="88" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="756" x2="390" y2="756" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- home -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,782 49,773 60,782" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="42" y="781" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="815" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
  </g>
  <!-- trips selected -->
  <g>
    <rect x="116" y="770" width="48" height="31" rx="15" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <rect x="128" y="777" width="23" height="16" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="782" x2="147" y2="782" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="787" x2="143" y2="787" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <text x="140" y="815" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#1B0188">Viajes</text>
  </g>
  <!-- benefits -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="238,774 241,781 249,782 243,787 245,795 238,791 231,795 233,787 227,782 235,781" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="238" y="815" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Beneficios</text>
  </g>
  <!-- account -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="333" cy="779" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="333" cy="792" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="333" y="815" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>
  </g>
</svg>
